svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Introduction to Kubernetes, slide 5 of 12: Deployments
svg.desc: Deployments: the Deployment frontend declares replicas: 3 and owns a ReplicaSet that owns the pods; when a pod crashes the controller starts a new copy, because it compares the desired state (3) with the actual state (2) every few seconds; kubectl scale deployment frontend --replicas=5 changes the goal to 5.
svg.text: You declare 3 copies. A controller compares that with reality and fixes every difference.
